legacy: CMD0/1/2 unchanged including zero reserved bytes; only CMD3 permits bytes7..10 payload
extension_ack: 5A A5 01 seq 20 op status reply_u32_le XOR; error uses result21 and byte6 error
audio: 5A A5 01 audio_seq 40 sample0_le16 sample1_le16 sample2_le16 XOR
audio_sequence: FPGA global uint8 counter increments for result40 AND result41, resets only on FPGA reset, NOT REC_START. ESP learns first packet per recording, checks all following packets including EOF modulo256, then verifies full sample count and PCM CRC. Learning start never waives count/CRC verification.

ops.0: CAP reply=0x0001000f with CHORD_SCORE_ENABLE=1 (bit3 chords); legacy=0x00010007. ESP47 supports both; only bit3 permits chord uploads.
ops.16: SCORE_BEGIN payload byte0 steps1..63,byte1 total_quarters9..252 includes2beats countin,bytes2..4 samples_per_beat u24 23437..187500; reject if display bank ack!=current activebank; clear inactive256 words beforeACK
ops.17: SCORE_WRITE byte0 sequential quarter address0..total_quarters-1; bytes1..4 word32 LE
ops.18: SCORE_COMMIT payload low16=sum16(all4 bytes of each quarter word); require complete count; activate staged config/bank and signal source restart if custom current
ops.32: MAP_BEGIN initialize inactive identity128 entries; defaultPads/CC fromV040; no active switch
ops.33: NOTE_WRITE byte0 index0..127 in order; byte1 outputNote0..127; rest0; sum16 += index+target
ops.34: PAD_WRITE byte0 padIndex0..3 sequential after128notes;byte1 incomingNote0..127; sum16 += index+value
ops.35: CC_WRITE byte0 knobIndex0..3 sequential after4pads;byte1 incomingCC0..127; sum16 += index+value
ops.36: MAP_COMMIT low16 expected_sum16; require136 writes; only if performance idle OR acknowledged explicit panic then activate and emit mapping_commit; never allow hanging held notes
ops.48: REC_START payload0; reject if recordbusy, reset samplecount/drops/CRC; first audio afterACK
ops.49: REC_STOP stop capture then drain queue and sendEOF; ack not EOF
ops.50: REC_CRC reply standard reflected IEEE CRC32 (EDB88320,initFFFFFFFF,finalxorFFFFFFFF) over real little endian sample bytes only, afterEOF; busy error beforeEOF
ops.51: REC_STATE reply bits31drop/30busy/29active and low29samplecount; status0
ops.20: GUIDE_CONTROL legacy0..3=custom; bit16=1 explicit song bits9:8(0..3), actionbits1:0(0 select paused,1start,2toggle,3restart); otherbitszero. Builtins need no custom upload. Test-owned rejects BUSY.
ops.38: MAP_DISABLE/restore exact V040 identity+GM aliases, payload0; idle+commit-ready required, acknowledge only after MIDI decoder commit ack
ops.21: GUIDE_MODE payload0fixedBPM/1auto/2step; resets selected score; ACK means accepted. Use op22 readback for actual mode and selection.

score_table: 2 banks x256 quarter entries; source/pixel each SDP BRAM; BEGINclear/write broadcast inactivebank; controller waits pixelbankack for safe reuse
mapping_ports: mapping_enable,bank,commit; wr_en,addr[7:0]={bank,index7},data[6:0]; active pad_notes[27:0] and cc_numbers[27:0], low7 index0

recording.eof_tail: last payload padded to3 samples; WAV uses exact EOF count; CRC excludes pad

scheduling: RX parser always active even duringTX; stop-and-waitRPC; ACK priority at packet boundaries; audio never blocks synth; duplicate identical seq/op/payload repeats cachedACK without repeating side effects; same seq different payload error
scope_limits: No physical latency claim; boxcar6 anti alias limited; no new pins/purchases; both FPGA+ESP must use1M paired, rollbackV040+ESP39 uses115200
guide_practice: Fresh raw melody NoteOn receipt plus all group physical held_keys required. Every target needs new NoteOn after step begins; release clears unaccepted member, suspended drops incomplete attempt. Once accepted, time continues for group duration. Repeated or common-note chords require re-strike. Rests/count-in run; no scoring system.

score_word_chord.constraints: valid=1; at leastdelta1; strictlyascending positiveoffsets then trailingzeros; all root+delta<=72; root41..72
score_word_chord.note: No next_note or per-event velocity in chordword; demo uses existing constantvelocity192 for mono andchord.
